title: English Practice Quiz 0966
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: A budget is a plan for ___.
questions.explanation: A budget helps plan how money will be received and used.

questions.question: An emergency fund is money set aside for ___.
questions.explanation: An emergency fund helps cover unforeseen costs.

questions.question: If expenses are greater than income, a person has a ___.
questions.explanation: A deficit occurs when spending exceeds income.

questions.question: Compound interest is interest calculated on ___.
options: the original amount and previously added interest
the original amount only in every case
questions.explanation: Compound interest earns interest on accumulated interest as well as principal.

questions.question: A fixed expense is one that ___.
options: usually stays similar from period to period
questions.explanation: Fixed expenses are relatively consistent, such as regular rent payments.

questions.question: Diversification means ___.
options: putting all money into one asset
questions.explanation: Diversification reduces dependence on a single investment.

questions.question: Inflation generally refers to ___.
options: a rise in the overall price level
questions.explanation: Inflation is a general increase in prices over time.

questions.question: Before taking a loan, it is important to compare ___.
options: interest rates, fees and repayment terms
the colour of the bank logo
questions.explanation: These factors affect the total cost and affordability of borrowing.

questions.question: A savings goal should ideally be ___.
questions.explanation: A clear and realistic goal is easier to plan and track.

questions.question: A bank's nominee is a person named to ___.
options: receive or claim account proceeds under applicable rules
questions.explanation: A nominee is designated to receive or claim proceeds according to applicable rules.
